name: correlliayards-root
description: Script orchestration only. The three projects under apps/ and packages/ each own their dependencies, their lockfile and their node_modules; this file installs and builds them in the order they depend on each other, and has no dependencies of its own.

scripts.install-all: cd packages/shared && npm install && cd ../../apps/api && npm install && cd ../../apps/web && npm install
scripts.ci-all: cd packages/shared && npm ci && cd ../../apps/api && npm ci && cd ../../apps/web && npm ci
scripts.dev-front: npm run build-shared && cd apps/web && npm run dev
scripts.build-front: npm run build-shared && cd apps/web && npm run build
scripts.build-api: npm run build-shared && cd apps/api && npm run build
scripts.start-api: npm run build-api && cd apps/api && npm run start
